content: पुष्टिः {%f.%} [पुष् भावे-क्तिन्] .²1 Nourishing, breeding, or rearing. .²2 Nourishment, growth, increase, advance; यत् पिंषतामपि नृणां पिष्टोऽपि तनोषि परिमलैः पुष्टिम् <ls>Bv. 1. 12</ls>. .²3 Strength, fatness, fulness, plumpness; अन्धस्य दृष्टिरिव पुष्टिरिवातुरस्य <ls>Mk. 1. 49</ls>. .²4 Prosperity, thriving. .²5 Maintenance, support. .²6 Wealth, property, means of comfort; तस्मिन्नपुष्यन्नुदिते समग्रां पुष्टिं जनाः पुष्य इव द्वितीये <ls>R. 18. 32</ls>. .²7 Richness, magnificence. .²8 Development, perfection. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a ceremony performed for the attainment of welfare; also पुष्टिकर्मन् <ab>q. v.</ab>
